statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was ordered
Diagnosis codes I49.9 and I48.0 were assigned
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
